get_loss_func_by_name: get a loss function class by name such as cross_entropy or mse_loss
list_available_losses: list all available loss function names registered in the _LOSSES dictionary
get_bce_loss: get the binary cross entropy loss class for binary classification tasks
get_label_smoothing_loss: get the label smoothing cross entropy loss class for regularized training
get_mse_loss: get the mean squared error loss class for regression tasks
